NewsArticle.Title: Consecration
NewsArticle.Content:
Consecration lets you select what kind of item you want to consecrate. This is very helpful so that you don't need to remove many items. There are several varieties of each item.
- Boots
- Bracer
- Earrings
- Gauntlet
- Greaves
- Ring
- Shield
For desecration you already need not remove items except those of your diety's enemy that you do not want to desecrate.
Please do not remove items when consecrating or descrating that you do not need to. They could be lost or stolen.
